title: The Demons Are Planning Something Good Anime Reveals Cast, More Staff, 2027 TV Debut
content: The official website for the anime of akuji Katō's The Demons Are Planning Something Good ( Ma no Mono-tachi wa Kuwadateru ) comedy manga revealed the anime's cast, more staff, visual, and 2027 television debut on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: 'Ma no Mono-tachi wa Kuwadateru' Announces Main Cast, Additional Staff, 2027 Premiere
content: An official website opened for the television anime adaptation of Takuji Katou and Gashigashi 's Ma no Mono-tachi wa Kuwadateru ( The Demons Are Planning Something Good! ) manga on Tuesday and revealed the main cast, additional staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime is planned to premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: New Sword Art Online Film Reveals Title, Cast, Staff, 2028 Debut
content: The Sword Art Online franchise announced on Tuesday that its new original film will open in theaters in 2028 under the title Sword Art Online -Integral Domain- . The film is based on an original story by Reki Kawahara and takes place after the Sword Art Online: Alicization story arc.
author: ANN

title: One of Anime’s Best Movies Is Returning to Theaters This August (& It’s Getting a Big Upgrade)
content: One of the best anime movies of all time is coming back to theaters to celebrate its 10th anniversary, and it’s getting a big upgrade for its comeback. Anime in theaters has been treated a lot differently than the trend began a decade or so ago.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Sword Art Online' Original Movie Announces Main Staff, 2028 Premiere
content: The official website for the Sword Art Online anime series revealed on Tuesday the main staff, official title, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser trailer for the previously announced original anime movie . The movie, titled Integral Domaine , is scheduled to open in theaters in 2028.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Legendary Gurren Lagann & Kill la Kill Creators Announce New Trigger Anime
content: The legendary creator duo behind hits such as Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann and Kill la Kill are returning for a new anime project, and fans are ready to see what’s next for Studio Trigger. The anime production studio has been one of the most notable production studios for the last decade.
author: ComicBook

title: Sword Art Online New Original Movie Directed by Shingo Adachi Gets 2028 Release Date & Staff Details
content: Sword Art Online revealed new information and details for its upcoming original anime movie titled Integral Domain . The film was teased with the words “a completely new original theatrical edition is in production” back in January 2024, while its initial announcement came in November 2022.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Sword Art Online Movie Teases Kirito & Asuna’s Return With First Look
content: Sword Art Online is returning to the big screen with a brand new feature film now in the works, and the first look teaser is gearing up for Kirito and Asuna’s big comeback. Sword Art Online’ s Reki Kawahara has a lot of different projects now in the works.
author: ComicBook
